hero.title: STUDY MBBS IN CHINA
hero.subtitle: Explore MBBS Opportunities in China 2026–2027. World-class medical infrastructure, mega hospital campuses, and globally ranked universities.

overview: China boasts some of the most technologically advanced medical institutions in the world. Attached hospitals routinely have 2,000 to 5,000 beds, giving Indian medical students exposure to high-volume clinical cases and state-of-the-art robotic medical technology.

universities.name: Nanjing Medical University

universities.desc: Formerly first military medical university, offering world-class biomechanical training.

faq.question: Is MBBS in China taught in English?
faq.answer: Yes, MOE-listed universities teach the full MBBS curriculum in English medium for international cohorts.

faq.question: What is the duration of MBBS in China?
faq.answer: The course duration is 6 years, consisting of 5 years academic medicine plus 1 year rotatory hospital internship.
